rho_reference.protocol: Named by the protocol (RESEARCH_GLV_INVARIANT_FACTOR_BASES.md section 9.15, registered before any E25 code, and inherited unchanged by E31's section 9.22 registration, c1c5378059): on each GLS curve the matched rho is the <±psi> walk, psi the GLS endomorphism (the p^2-power Frobenius twisted back to E, psi^2 = -1), a class {±P, ±psi P} of 4 points; 16 <±psi>, 16 negation and 16 unfolded walks per (p, seed), all run and all verified, in the same process as both index-calculus arms. S / rho = total F_p multiplications of the arm / mean F_p multiplications of the 16 <±psi> walks (set-up and class representatives included). Strongest available: E31 runs on E25's ten instances (identical n, #E, h and base points, checked leaf by leaf), on which j(E) is in F_p2 but not in F_p (checked independently by the E25 validator), so psi is the only Frobenius-type endomorphism over F_p4 and Aut(E) = {±1}: <±psi> is the largest fold. Unpriced native work (AGENTS.md section 5a): both arms charge F_p multiplications only; the index calculus leaves unpriced its Macaulay-matrix entry traffic (emitted as macaulay_entries; a fallback charges its extra matrix), its F_p additions, the existing solver's echelon/triangularise inversions, per-phase row scans, and for solver B the pivot-selection nonzero counts (not emitted; lower bound 2 E_E25 - E_E31 entry reads per record, priced here); the walks leave unpriced each step's hash lookup/insert and partition hash (emitted as steps). Band: S(g) = F_p multiplications + g * GAE * native operations, one native operation per Macaulay entry (plus, for B, per entry read by its nonzero-count pass) or walk step, GAE = 97.0 F_p multiplications per affine addition (measured on every record), g = 0, 0.1, 1. gae_band values: medians over the ten curves of solver B (chain-sparsest), arm B (the GLS-fold arm, E25's benchmark arm), with B's pass priced, against the matched <±psi> walk. The matched walk is below every one of the 60 IC rows (E25, A, B; both arms; ten curves) at every weight, by 10^3-10^6x, so the order rho < IC holds across the band. Within the index calculus: A < E25 at every weight under the registered model (G2.94); B < E25 and B < A at 0 GAE only, unresolved across the band (validator-report.json counting_honesty.native_work).
rho_reference.unit: F_p multiplications: both arms counted by the same Fp4 counters (an F_p4 multiplication 19, an inversion 40), the solve's F_p multiplications counted directly (inversions in the chain solve's new phases at 2 ceil(log2 p)), the Wiedemann matrix at 16 per multiplication mod n; walk set-up included
